svg.text: THE FULL BELT - TWO PER FAN, EACH A CHAIN OF THREE 100 mm TIES
corners are taken by the grille screws - the belts take the whole fan instead
FROM INSIDE - two belts, upper and lower third
each belt: through a hex hole LEFT of the fan, across the grille,
through a hex hole RIGHT, chain closed behind the panel
THE CHAIN - three 100 mm ties = one ~260 mm tie:
tail of each tie into the buckle of the next; the wrap needs ~210 mm,
two chained (~175) fall short, three clear it with slack to cinch
1 panel off the rack; fan inside, rim arrow pointing IN
2 chain three ties; belt through hex LEFT - grille - hex RIGHT
3 close behind the panel, cinch hard, fan pressed flat
4 second belt, other third; heads tidy, tails snipped
5 finger-spin the rotor - belts ride the guard, clear of blades
6 remount panel, leads aft to A1 (6 ties per fan, 12 + spares)
